verifications.evidence: UI/zestIcons.tsx:161 now guards the lookup with Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(ZEST_ICON_ELEMENTS, name), so inherited Object.prototype keys such as __proto__, constructor, toString, valueOf and hasOwnProperty fall through to null instead of being treated as icons. The shipped dist/index.esm.js contains the same guard. __tests__/ZestIcon.test.tsx covers those inherited names, and the ZestIcon plus semanticTypeIcons suites pass (70 tests, 4 suites).
